plan: Given my value of $9, I aim to bid below $9 to avoid a loss. Bidding exactly $9 or higher is dominated because it risks paying more than the value. I will bid slightly above a minimum value to potentially win if others bid low, maximizing profit by reducing costs. As this is the only round, I will bid $1. This ensures a potential win if others bid extremely low, with minimal risk.
